title: Bound on influential coordinates
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function. Write $I$ for its total influence, and suppose $I>0$. For $psilon>0$, the number of coordinates whose probability of being pivotal for $f$ is at least $\varepsilon^2 I^{-2}9^{-k}$ is at most $I^3\varepsilon^{-2}9^k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $\{-1,1\}^n$ with values in $\{-1,1\}$
The total influence $I$ of $f$ is positive
